genders.label: Mixed doubles ranking
genders.explanation: Men and women are ranked separately in mixed doubles. Every pair has one of each, so results show how men compare with men and women with women, but not how men's and women's ratings compare.

heading: Rankings
intro: Every player's rating in each discipline. Ranked players have played in the last 12 months; the arrows show the change since last week.

junior.heading: Junior rankings (U19)
junior.intro: Every junior's rating in each discipline, from matches in junior classes and junior leagues only: results against seniors don't count here. The arrows show the change since last week.

combined.explanation: Singles, doubles and mixed doubles together, for everyone ranked in at least two of them: the average of how far each of their ratings is above or below the others', in standard deviations, so each discipline counts the same. A discipline a player isn't ranked in counts as their weaker one, so specialists are ranked too, but leaving one out never helps.
combined.summary: {count} players ranked in at least two of the three disciplines.
combined.juniorSummary: {count} juniors ranked in at least two of the three disciplines: born in {year} or later, with junior matches in the last 12 months.

combined.notRanked: Not ranked in this discipline: counts as their weaker one
